title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — Fluid Substrate Metadata
description: Defines metadata fields for fluid substrates within the Fluids Seen Layer, including laminarity, turbulence, viscosity, continuity, and flow-state resonance.
note: This metadata schema is used by fs.list, fs.read, fs.search, and all L2 fluidic tools.

viscosity.description: Internal friction of the fluid medium (0.0–1.0).

continuity.description: Preservation of identity across flow transitions (0.0–1.0).

pressureGradient.description: Directional pressure change across the fluid field.

flowIntegrity.description: Overall stability and coherence of the flow-state.

resonanceSignature.description: Symbolic signature describing the substrate’s resonance behavior.

reality.details: Metadata fields are returned from the fluid substrate definition.

imagination.details: The fluid field forms a stable laminar channel with high continuity.

information.details: Fluidic metadata inherits qmroot lineage through frequency into seen-layer dynamics.
